instruction: A candid full-shot photograph in a bright indoor ballet studio. The woman in the black leotard (R1) stands behind the young girl in the pink tutu (R2). Both raise their arms upward in a high ballet pose, with the instructor (R1) positioning her hands slightly apart above the student. The young girl (R2) looks up toward her raised hands in profile, while the instructor (R1) looks forward. Soft, natural light fills the room, creating a gentle and focused atmosphere with a shallow depth of field.
